summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 62 of the CipherBox project — a 'Unified Node Codec (Core Keystone)' that replaces legacy `FolderMetadata`/`FileMetadata` types with a unified `Node` type, implementing dual-sealed bodies and generation-as-AAD across the monorepo.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (9 plans / 7 waves, all verification gates passed, 6/6 requirements + 9/9 decisions covered). Execution ran through Wave 6 (62-08a web logic-layer) with 7/9 plans complete; `folder/` and `file/` deleted, core/sdk-core/sdk all compiling against `Node`, 228 core tests green before cutover, 190 after (retired suites correctly removed).

repo: Phase 62 is the v2.0 keystone: `packages/core/src/folder/` and `packages/core/src/file/` deleted entirely; new `packages/core/src/node/` module (types, encode, decode, seal, barrel) replaces both.
Compile-gate chain is strictly ordered: core dist → sdk-core tsc → sdk tsc → web tsc. Each consumer typechecks against upstream built `dist/`, not source.
Nyquist validation requires a `## Validation Architecture` section in RESEARCH.md to trigger VALIDATION.md generation; without it, Dimension-8 validation requirements are absent from plans.
`workflow.auto_advance: true` in config would normally chain plan-phase → execute-phase automatically; it must be consciously overridden for high-blast-radius keystone phases.
pnpm monorepo worktrees lack `node_modules` at creation time — sequential execution on the main tree is faster and more reliable than parallel worktrees for this repo.

`file-ipns.test.ts` imported from `../file/derive-ipns` and `../file/metadata` (retired), NOT from the live `ipns/` module. The live IPNS module (`create-record.ts`, `sign-record.ts`) has its own separate passing tests and was untouched.
Retired type names (`FolderMetadata`, `FileMetadata`, etc.) appear in 5 core source files post-cutover, but all are migration comments — core tsc clean confirms zero live references.
The 228→190 core test count drop (−38) is exactly accounted for: `folder-metadata.test.ts` (17 tests) + `file-ipns.test.ts` (21 tests) — both legitimately retired.
schema-gate hook scans for ORM files (Prisma/Drizzle/TypeORM); Phase 62 touches only `packages/core` crypto codec, so gate is silently skipped — DB schema lives in `apps/api` (Phase 66).
The pattern-mapper found 13/14 analogs: `folder/metadata.ts` codec, `crypto/seal.ts` primitive, `vault/blob.ts` v3, and `vault-blob-vectors.test.ts` golden vectors were the key templates.
Golden vectors for vault v3 blob must live in `tests/vectors/vault-v3-blob.json` (committed), not inline in plan — required for cross-language Rust parity (Phase 69 slot).
Vault v3 blob layout: `0x03 | u16_BE(readLen) | ECIES(rootReadKey) | u16_BE(writeLen) | ECIES(rootWriteKey)` — two-key format, `encryptedRootFolderKey` field removed.

code.finding: New module created this phase: types.ts, encode.ts, decode.ts, seal.ts, and barrel index.ts. This is the single source of truth for the unified Node codec going forward.
Frozen golden vectors committed in Wave 2 (before any consumer seals): body-bytes primary lock (IV-independent) + fixed-key/fixed-IV full-seal lock. Phase-69 Rust test slots into this file.
Committed cross-language vector for vault v3 two-key blob format. Must be in tests/vectors/ (not inline) to satisfy D-04 and enable cross-language parity checks.
Barrel cutover: all folder/ and file/ exports replaced with ./node exports. This is the structural keystone of Wave 3 (plan 62-05).

workflow: `gsd-tools query commit` has a known false-negative: it reports `commit_failed` but the commit actually lands. Always verify with `git log --oneline -1` rather than retrying the commit.
Plan-checker blocker: RESEARCH.md open questions must have `(RESOLVED)` markers added after analysis — the gate checks for these explicitly.
Plan size threshold ~43 files: plan 62-08 was split into 62-08a (logic layer) + 62-08b (component layer + final typecheck gate) to prevent context exhaustion in unsupervised execution.
Partial-tsc verify commands should mask non-zero exit codes via trailing `|| true` / `echo` so the gate result is inspectable even when errors exist — bare `tsc` failing aborts the task script.

Web test quarantine must use grep-discovery for retired-type imports rather than hardcoding 2 known test files — the actual blast radius across web test files is larger than the plan initially assumed.
API-surface intel hook regenerated but extracted 0 symbols (HINT-only file for this phase) — safe to omit from planner prompt when empty rather than injecting noise.
PATTERNS.md committed by the pattern-mapper subagent is NOT auto-committed by step 13d (which only commits PLAN/STATE/ROADMAP) — must be committed explicitly after the mapper returns.

Drift precheck is non-blocking even when flagging 143 elements — it means the codebase map baseline is stale/missing, not that Phase 62 introduced drift. Run `/gsd-map-codebase` separately to refresh.
